\section*{True / False (26 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Applications developed by \duallayerbox{programming languages}{markup languages} like \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_ have this common \duallayerbox{buffer-overflow}{memory leak} error.' is 'C, C++'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'When a wireless user authenticates to any AP, both of them go in the course of \duallayerbox{four-step}{three-step}rbox{four-step}{two-step} authentication progression which is called...' is 'wireless handshaking'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'In \duallayerbox{MD-5}{SHA-1} the length of the message digest is' is '\duallayerbox{128}{256}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What are the port states determined by \duallayerbox{Nmap}{Wireshark}?' is '\duallayerbox{Open, filtered, unfiltered}{Closed, open, stealth}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Can a \duallayerbox{stream cipher}{block cipher} have \duallayerbox{perfect secrecy}{complete security}?' is 'No, since the key is shorter than the message'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not an example of \duallayerbox{presentation layer issues}{network layer problems}?' is 'Weak or non-existent authentication mechanisms'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What tool can be used to perform \duallayerbox{SNMP enumeration}{packet analysis}?' is 'IP Network Browser'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A \duallayerbox{session symmetric key}{asymmetric key} between two parties is used' is 'Only once'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Man in the middle attack can endanger the security of Diffie Hellman method if two parties are not' is 'Joined'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'How is IP address spoofing detected?' is 'Comparing the TTL values of the actual and spoofed addresses'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not a block cipher operating mode?' is 'CBF'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The message must be encrypted at the sender site and decrypted at the' is 'Sender Site'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What does EXE do when the STP solver times out on a constraint query for a particular path?' is 'Assume that the query is not satisfiable and stop executing the path'.
\end{enumerate}
